about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every XE 2.0d on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XE 2.0d from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The XE 2.0d is powered exclusively by the AJ200D diesel engine across its production run. This means there is no engine-code variation for this specific variant — every XE 2.0d uses the same basic unit, though later revisions of the Ingenium diesel may have minor updates. We always confirm your exact engine via registration to ensure the correct parts and procedures.
